about: Structure inventory for ikas-ecommerce.lib.pen (references/12-library.md). Parts, states and port marks only: no value, no layout. Layer and state names follow 02-contract.md §9 and 06-page-coverage.md §3; this file adds the evidence-backed must-haves. Part flags: req = always present and enabled; opt = present but enabled:false, switched on by the theme. ikas: yes = storefront API supports it, no = not in ikas (06 §3b), check = not verified yet.

basis.baymard: usability research: the share of large sites that get it wrong
basis.platform: every major theme platform has it; no usability evidence

kinds.sub: reusable root P/Sub/<Name>; becomes src/sub-components/<Name>; a host part that names it (`sub`) holds an instance
kinds.block: parts folded into every host part that names it (`block`); never a root of its own on a theme canvas
kinds.section: section root P/Section/<Name>@desktop|@mobile; content sections are copied under the theme's own section key, matched by plandata `archetype` family

states.odak: focus-visible ring; every interactive part (baymard: 48% drop it)
states.indirimli: sale price with struck compare price
